en.t: No, you do not need to thank me.

units.source_text: 虽然我收了你做我的弟子，但是你能不能得道成仙，也要全看你自己的悟性了。

en.t: Although I have taken you as my disciple, whether you can attain the Way and become an immortal depends entirely on your own understanding.

units.source_text: 无论如何，你先跟我进峨眉山看看吧。

en.t: In any case, first come with me into Mount Emei and have a look.

units.source_text: 嗯，你快骑上落在此地的竹杖，飞过去吧。”

en.t: Now, quickly mount the bamboo staff that has fallen here and fly over there.
